passages.context: Paragraphs 4-5 were read with the complete homily. They read the healed Samaritan together with Naaman as two non-Jews opened by faith to bodily and spiritual healing, then present salvation as universal yet historically mediated through Israel, fulfilled in Christ, and continued in the Church.
passages.notes: The HTML does not print paragraph numbers. The locator counts the three-line salutation as paragraph 1. No comparison with the Italian version is claimed.
